title: An abstract drawing from the 73,000-year-old levels at Blombos Cave, South Africa
bibliographicNote: Nature 562, 115–118. Abstract and original Supplementary Information consulted, especially microscopic and chemical analyses of L13 and experimental marking. The CNRS research-team release supplies a readable account of the dated layer and nine drawn lines; it is separately cited. Drawing on silcrete is distinguished from engraved ochre.
